====================================================================================================
PART A — TITLE: Work Order Page – Lead Technician List Stops After 100 People
====================================================================================================

h2. Description

On a work order page, *the Lead Technician list offers only the first 100 people*, so a technician who can lead work at the location but whose name sorts later *cannot be chosen as lead from the work order page*.

For example,
* a location has 184 people who can lead work
* the list, scrolled to its end, stops after the 100th name, then shows the current lead
* the field has no search box, so scrolling is the only way to reach a name
* the same later technicians ARE offered in the board's *Reassign lead technician* dialog

This appears inconsistent with the lead changes defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10047*), which the test cases below expect to be made from the work order page.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin and check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Open any Approved work order (e.g. *Work Orders* > *All* > search {{ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign}} > *S2-36154*).
# On the card at the left, click *Lead Technician* and scroll the list to the end.
#* The list ends with *QA Foreman*, then the current lead: 101 entries in all (*Unassigned*, 100 people, then the current lead).
#* *Ralph Edwards* is not in it.
# Type {{Ralph Edwards}} into the Lead Technician field.
#* No text appears in the field and the list does not change.
# Go to *Work Orders* > *All* > *Board View*, open any card's *…* menu > *Reassign lead technician* and type {{Ral}} in its search box.
#* *Ralph Edwards* is offered.

*Actual Result:*
* The work order page offers only the first 100 people as lead; *Ralph Edwards* cannot be chosen there.
* The same person is offered as lead in the *Reassign lead technician* dialog.

*Expected Result:*
* A technician who can lead work at the location can be chosen as lead on the work order page, as the test cases expect: *"Step 6: Lead Technician reads "Ralph Edwards" and Mileage reads 120,500."* and *"Step 4: Lead Technician is Ben Bravo."*

!D-LEAD100-2-lead-list-staging-vs-production.png|width=1000!

* *Example records:* work order [S2-36154|https://app.staging.shopview.com/workorders] (ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom 13769 Aardvark Co), list read 15 Oct 2026 11:42 UTC; Reassign dialog picture: work order S2-35470 (ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dialog Search), 15 Oct 2026 03:42 UTC
* *People:* 184 people can lead at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 (the Reassign dialog's list); *Ralph Edwards* — active, Time Clock on, Technician role, offered by the Reassign dialog
* *Also missing:* *ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo* was not in the list on work order S2-36155 (read 15 Oct 2026 10:06 UTC), where he was not the lead; on S2-36154 he is the current lead, so he shows at the end
* *Production:* [app.shopview.com|https://app.shopview.com/workorders], build v26.40.18-163ddfa, work order S2-968, read 15 Oct 2026 11:46 UTC — only 18 active staff, so the list holds everyone (10 entries) and the limit cannot be shown there; typing does not narrow it there either

====================================================================================================
PART B — TITLE: Edit Line – Add Technician List Stops Before Later Technicians
====================================================================================================

h2. Description

In a work order line's *Edit Line* window, *the Add Technician list stops before the technicians whose names sort later*, so such a technician *cannot be added to a line*.

For example,
* the list, scrolled to its end, stops at *QA PartsTechnician* (97 names)
* *Ralph Edwards*, an active technician at the location, is not in it
* the field has no search box, so scrolling is the only way to reach a name

This appears inconsistent with the line technician changes covered for *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10047*), which the test case below expects to work for *Ralph Edwards*.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin and check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Open any Approved work order with a labor line (e.g. *Work Orders* > *All* > search {{ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign}} > *S2-36154*).
# On the *Lines* tab click the line's name (e.g. *Service - Cabin air filter*) to open *Edit Line*.
# Click *Add Technician* and scroll the list to the end.
#* The list ends at *QA PartsTechnician* (97 names, starting *Aaron Baker*).
#* *Ralph Edwards* is not in it.
# Type {{Ralph Edwards}} into the Add Technician field.
#* No text appears in the field and the list does not change.
# Close the window without saving (do not press *Save & Close*).

*Actual Result:*
* *Ralph Edwards* cannot be added as a line's technician; the list stops at *QA PartsTechnician*.

*Expected Result:*
* *Ralph Edwards* can be added as the line's technician, as the test case expects: *"Step 5: the line shows "Ralph Edwards" as its technician."*

!D-LEAD100-3-editline-staging-vs-production.png|width=1000!

h2. Environment

* *Build:* <read off the staging page at the re-measure before filing> on [staging|https://app.staging.shopview.com/workorders] (Staging Heavy Duty - 9919)
* *Example record:* work order [S2-36154|https://app.staging.shopview.com/workorders], line *Service - Cabin air filter* (technician ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo, unchanged — nothing was saved), list read 15 Oct 2026 11:45 UTC
* *Production:* [app.shopview.com|https://app.shopview.com/workorders], build v26.40.18-163ddfa, work order S2-968, read 15 Oct 2026 11:47 UTC — only 18 active staff, so the list holds everyone (9 entries) and the limit cannot be shown there; typing does not narrow it there either; nothing was saved
